heard: A glowing beam of energy shoots 5,000 light years across space. Messii 87 is a massive galaxy with trillions of stars. Fifty-five million light years away, it dwarfs our Milky Way with 15,000 globular clusters. In 1918, astronomer Heber Curtis of Lick Observatory spotted a bizarre straight ray erupting from the core. The jet creates a trick, appearing to move faster than light. This optical illusion occurs as matter blasts toward Earth at nearly the speed of light. It is powered by a black hole 6.5 billion times heavier than our Sun. In 2019, the Event Horizon Telescope revealed the first direct image of this gravitational monster's shadow. This massive anchor provides the raw power for the glowing beam of energy shooting across space.
